subject: Semantic acquisition shortcut
engineering_problem: A proposed speedup would let a ready provider search and one successful symbol lookup certify acquisition completeness. It would fetch only the first matching declaration page, reuse cached witness validation until the path changes, and publish the richer acquired facts even when the caller requested lower fidelity. Assess whether this preserves the existing contract and propose a defensible alternative.
required_reasoning: Provider success/health and lookup results are advisory or lower-bound,not complete acquisition proof.
Declaration mode requires complete supported producer-unit proof;occurrence search/lower bounds and answer narrowing are distinct.
Preserve exact source-qualified domain-local refinement and independent declaration versus role/payload.
Retain source/hash/witness/dependency currentness,not path-only cache truth or unproved stable operation.
Acquisition cannot silently upgrade publication fidelity.
Discover historical ready-provider root-satisfaction failure/repair;propose only measured operation-local preserving reuse within proven bounds and separately approved architectural scope.
